prompt: Convert the World War II notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/world-war-2-notes.md, analyze all the historical facts, dates, events, causes, and consequences described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards covering the war's timeline, key battles, leaders, causes, and consequences. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/world-war-2-notes-flashcards.md.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 25 flashcards

assertions.name: has_date_facts
assertions.description: Contains at least 5 flashcards with dates

assertions.name: has_type_variety
assertions.description: Uses at least 5 different card types

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments, markdown headers, or metadata
